other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage in Cross-Validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs out-of-fold target encoding before model training, but uses the exact same K-Fold splits (with the same random seed) for both the encoding and the model cross-validation. This causes the target-encoded features in the training folds to be computed using target values from the validation fold, leading to target leakage.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated solution with extensive domain-specific feature engineering, target encoding, and optimized blending. However, the pipeline contains two notable data leakage issues: extracting test set distribution information by fitting aggregations on the concatenated train/test sets, and utilizing identical K-Fold splits for both OOF target encoding and model training (which leaks validation targets into the training features).
